title: Have been to mall world multiple times but always at random and never become lucid really
content: How do I start going to mall world on purpose at my own will? Or becoming lucid in it? Sometimes I get really close to becoming lucid because I’ll face a difficulty of some kind and think “omg this is so crazy like my dreams I have sometimes” or “I’ve only seen a ladder like this before in my dreams”. I also on random occasions feel like I’ve had more control / somewhat complete control of what I’m doing but still don’t realize I’m dreaming is that considered slightly lucid? Also is it possible for me to find people in mall world from my life that have passed away? Ik lots of questions. Pls answer any yall can
